<awtsmoosMeluketTranslation heichel="ikar" alias="meluket_translation_en" seriesId="ניסן_meluket" postId="BH_POST_1766518917845_theRebbe_238" batchId="meluket-_D7_A0_D7_99_D7_A1_D7_9F_meluket__BH_POST_1766518917845_theRebbe_238__p003">
  <section v="6">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>This section discusses the conclusion of the Passover days, particularly the seventh and eighth days, and the connection to the revelation of Moshiach and the ultimate redemption.</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">4)</t>
    <t s="1">And may it be His will,</t>
    <t s="2">and especially as they conclude</t>
    <t s="3">(as is customary)</t>
    <t s="4">with the giving of charity25,</t>
    <t s="5">in the manner that the conclusion of all the days of Pesach is on the seventh day of Pesach,</t>
    <t s="6">and moreover, the conclusion of all the days of Pesach</t>
    <t s="7">(outside the Land)</t>
    <t s="8">is on the last day of Pesach, on which the revelation of the illumination of Moshiach shines26,</t>
    <t s="9">therefore the haftarah of the last day of Pesach is about the coming of Moshiach</t>
    <t s="10">[And one can connect this also with the eighth day of Pesach,</t>
    <t s="11">for in the haftarah it is written27</t>
    <t s="12">"On that day, the Lord will again set His hand a second time to acquire the remnant of His people that will remain from seven places of exile</t>
    <t s="13">(Ashur,</t>
    <t s="14">Mitzrayim etc., and the eighth—the islands of the sea)</t>
    <t s="15">and bring them to the state of the eighth—the state of the true and complete redemption],</t>
    <t s="16">and the prophecy will be fulfilled28</t>
    <t s="17">simply and in all details, and also in the inwardness—"the earth will be filled with knowledge of Havayah as the waters29</t>
    <t s="18">cover the sea30."</t>
  </section>
</awtsmoosMeluketTranslation>
